SELECT DATE(pay_time) AS statDate, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM service_order WHERE
AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{start} AND pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(pay_time) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT od.service_id AS serviceId, COALESCE(MAX(si.name), MAX(od.name)) AS name, SUM(od.quantity) AS sales, SUM(od.amount) AS amount FROM order_detail od INNER JOIN service_order o ON o.id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN service_item si ON si.id = od.service_id WHERE
GROUP BY od.service_id ORDER BY sales DESC, od.service_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
